name: disk-doctor
description: Diagnose Windows disk usage with a visual treemap map, then relocate large folders with directory junctions so programs keep working.

displayDescription.en: See at a glance who is eating your disk space; tick scattered files to clean; move big folders off the C drive.
displayDescription.zh: 一眼看清硬盘地图，谁在吃空间；一键勾选清理深度碎文件；大目录搬运瘦身C盘

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我看看C盘是什么东西最占空间
defaultInitPrompt.en: Show me what is taking up the most space on my C drive

tags.zh: 深度碎文件可视化清理

quickPrompts.en: Show me what is taking up the most space on my C drive
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我看看C盘是什么东西最占空间

quickPrompts.en: Summarize a C-drive cleanup list I can tick to delete
quickPrompts.zh: 给我总结一份C盘清理清单，让我可以一键勾选要删哪些

quickPrompts.en: Move that huge folder to another drive, keep the program working
quickPrompts.zh: 把那个特别大的文件夹搬到别的盘，程序还要照常用
